metrics_contract.fragmentation: sum of observed segments minus one within each visible episode; segment breaks on a frame gap or track_id change
metrics_contract.miss_bursts: max consecutive visible non-ambiguous episode frames without an observation; episodes never cross burst/clip/source boundaries
metrics_contract.reacquisition: missed frame count and device PTS milliseconds from the prior observation to the first subsequent observation
